review: Independent Bass and Lead behavior review
status: No defect found in the focused independent checks
scope: Development evidence for selected existing factory presets; not acoustic equivalence, native plugin qualification, or full-bank headroom qualification. No production sources or thresholds were changed.

identity.source_observation_note: Recipe, DSP and test hashes match A14. The copied capture and its exported 200-parameter inventory bind the actual audio conditions. Master-level calibration was still in progress; this review does not assert final-bank headroom or compiled equivalence to the contemporaneous level include.

reused_evidence.origin: A14 development Bass/Lead review; these suites were not repeated by worker 27.

independent_audio.parameter_digest_match: Every capture digest matched all 200 exported float32 parameters using FNV-1a.
independent_audio.harmonic_measurement: Hann-windowed stereo mean, power of harmonics 2–12 relative to the main-rank fundamental; +/-max(3 Hz, 2 FFT bins) integration. Finite floor values are not measurements below that floor.

results.late_note: Late level reaches the analysis floor; the numeric decay ratio is a lower bound rather than a measurable acoustic decay.

results.spectral_note: Fixed-pitch harmonic ratio omitted: pitch switching or exact silence makes this metric inapplicable.
Fixed-pitch harmonic ratio omitted: pitch switching or exact silence makes this metric inapplicable.

independent_pitch_telemetry.method: Actual programLibrary values rendered in a copied core library. Main rank oscillator frequency sampled from getRankInfo after each 256-frame render block; diagnostic engine telemetry, not an independent audio pitch estimate.

findings: Picked Bass retains a ringing body about 10 dB below onset at 0.8–1.1 s and damps by at least 39 dB at 3.5–3.9 s in both tested registers and velocities.
Picked Bass firm-versus-soft onset differences are 6.80 dB at MIDI 36 and 6.28 dB at MIDI 60; body response follows the same direction.
Rubber Bass damps substantially faster: body about 28.86 dB below onset, with its late signal at the analysis floor.

Sine Bass and Sine Lead maintain fundamental-dominated output: summed harmonics 2–12 are 32.81 and 47.47 dB below the fundamental in the tested window. These are circuit outputs, not mathematically pure sinusoids.
Pressure Lead is exactly silent at zero pressure and responds at full pressure, with -26.44 dBFS body RMS and -16.13 dBFS peak in this capture.
Glide Lead follows a continuous fractional pitch trajectory; Glissando Lead visits semitone steps 60 through 72; Trill Lead alternates approximately +/-1 semitone at 6.000 Hz.
limitations: Only the named programs, registers, velocities, pressure extremes, sample rate and windows were checked independently.
The parent owns complete final-bank headroom qualification after master-level calibration.
No listening panel, acoustic reference matching, native host operation or all-platform build qualification is claimed.
